title: IM60028: Environmental Impact And Risk Assessment
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Environment Impact Analysis – definition, need and scope, comparison with
technology assessment and social impact assessment. Legal aspects and
statutory regulations, Procedures for EIA, factors to be considered, personnel
to be involved, public participation and communication, Method of EIA: Popular
methods such as, Chainlist Matrices, Numerical methods, Battelle Environmental
evaluation system, etc.
Use of Delphi and its variants, KSIM, System Dynamics, Mathematical programming
and structural modelling methods for EIA Drawbacks in the present procedure and
implementation and their remedies.
Risk assessment in environmental issues, definition, need and scope, procedure
for risk assessment, methods of risk assessment, exposure evaluation using
qualitative and quantitative methods, model public hearing sessions.
Books
•Environmental Management in Practice: Vol 3 - Managing the Ecosystem, Bhaskar
Nath, Luc Hens, Paul Compton, Dimitri Devuyst (Editors), Taylor and Francis,
1999.
•Air Pollution, H.C.V.Rao, McGraw Hill Co., 1990.
